name: KeyBar
description: Menu-bar app to set up and configure OnlyKey devices (unofficial fork of the OnlyKey App)

scripts.prerelease: rm -rf ./node_modules/* && npm install --omit=dev && rm -rf ./release_node_modules && mkdir release_node_modules && cd release_node_modules && mkdir node_modules && cd .. && cp -R ./node_modules/* ./release_node_modules/node_modules && npm install && npm run build -- --env=production
scripts.prerelease_win: rm -rf ./node_modules/* && npm install --omit=dev && rm -rf ./release_node_modules && mkdir release_node_modules && cd release_node_modules && mkdir node_modules && cd .. && cp -R ./node_modules/* ./release_node_modules/node_modules && npm install && npm run build_win -- --env=production
